title: The Business Seeder stands a Space up the way a member-created Space is (LIVE-1200)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21: the seeders were standardized, the business one never was. Analysis at /mnt/project-files/seeders/seeders-analysis-2026-10-21.md.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE RE-TESTED: materialize.ts provisionSpace re-implemented the Space insert and skipped what createSpace does, so a seeded Space got no per-type tool defaults, no setup preset, no starter CRM stages, no Focus or directory kind, and a hard-coded skin. Both roads now call lib/spaces/provision-core.ts (spaceBirthConfig before the insert, finishSpaceBirth after the owner seat). Still open from the analysis, as separate rows when worked: the seeder's re-apply overwrites a claimed Space's edits, adoptSpaceMasterProfile has no admin check, the review board still hand-rolls its edit plumbing, and the seeder bypasses the governed create.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=fs.readFileSync('lib/importer/materialize.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('lib/spaces/provision.ts','utf8');const bad=[];for(const [n,s] of [['materialize',m],['provision',p]]){if(!s.includes('provision-core'))bad.push(n+' does not use the shared birth steps')}if(/skin: 'dawn'/.test(m))bad.push('seeder hard-codes the skin');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1200: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the seeder or createSpace stops sharing the birth steps.
